title: Trace a diagram entity to relevant code
statement: As an Architect or Developer reviewing an implementation deck, I can follow a referenced System, Component, or data entity to the particular code relevant to the slide and return without losing my place.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Opening code from a referenced slide Item identifies the code subset selected for that use, separately from the entity's complete code references.
The displayed code identifies its source commit, path, and exact range, and reports stale or unresolved references rather than silently substituting other code.
Returning from the code view restores the originating deck, slide, and Item context.
